What I find fascinating here is that a journalist like you doesn’t seem to care at all about an actual fraud and its impact on an election.  You’re not curious what happened here? Or is your ire and inquiry just directed at things that hurt your political allies instead of help them?
Yeah I think fraud polls are bad and you can still believe that and lock in to support AES. Doing anything else seems to be sanctioning fraud.
